selection.basis: A00065 was independently consumed PASS by C00071/Q00003. Immutable Release/atlas geometry is reused; active outrun-first-pass-edit-v2 is a changed QA fingerprint requiring direct decoded-source classification, source-effect masks and CLEAN_PLATE before rendering.

material_advance.description: Converts C-accepted pre-v2 Release/atlas geometry into 94 executable v2 direct-inspection work units with exact atlas cells, 2px guards, deterministic size-derived payload templates, header confirmation, semantic classification/binding, source-effect-mask and clean-plate output contracts.

reused_immutable_evidence.reason: Q00003 accepted 20 immutable upstream objects, 94/94 exact x4 region relations and 92 canonical semantic pairs; those heavy checks are reused.
